title: Everyday Phrases — Congratulating a Friend
scene_zh: 祝賀朋友 · 情境對話
title_quote: You called me three times tonight.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎉 實用祝賀朋友必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Congratulating a Friend
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用祝賀朋友情境對話：從半夜的那通報喜電話、見面道賀問細節、商量請客送禮訂餐廳，到聚餐致詞、拍照、回家後的感謝與新約定，每兩句成一組（男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Congratulating a Friend phrase pairs, from the late-night good-news phone call and face-to-face congratulations to planning the treat, the dinner toast, photos and the thank-you texts afterwards (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You called me three times tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am too excited to sit still.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm tu ɪkˈsaɪtɪd tə sɪt stɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You sound a little out of breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju saʊnd ə ˈlɪtl aʊt əv brɛθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am jumping around my kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, tell me everything now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I got the job, the design studio!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt ðə dʒɑb, ðə dɪˈzaɪn ˈstudioʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 我得到工作了，那間設計工作室！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the studio near the river?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they emailed me an hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ iˈmeɪld mi ən ˈaʊər əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，他們一小時前寄信給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you sure it says yes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clearly says welcome aboard.
dialogue.zh: 上面清楚寫著歡迎加入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you read the whole email twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju rɛd ðə hoʊl ˈiˌmeɪl twaɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read it maybe five times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am smiling so wide right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈsmaɪlɪŋ soʊ waɪd raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在笑得嘴都咧開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My face hurts from smiling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you tell your mom already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I wanted you first.
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我想第一時間告訴你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is really sweet of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You believed in me all year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, you worked so hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine interviews, one good result.
dialogue.zh: 九次面試，換來一個好結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, let me sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound like my worried dad.
dialogue.zh: 你聽起來像我那愛擔心的爸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am walking across my room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, twice around the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do they want you there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first Monday of next month.
dialogue.zh: 下個月的第一個星期一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is really soon, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, my work bag is still empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ, maɪ wərk bæɡ ɪz stɪl ˈɛmti./
dialogue.zh: 我知道，我的公事包還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they mention the pay again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same number as the interview.
dialogue.zh: 跟面試時說的數字一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that part matters most.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers my rent easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the bus from your place?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three stops, about ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect location, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep saying it out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me the team size again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six people and one office cat.
dialogue.zh: 六個人加一隻辦公室貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is my kind of job.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我喜歡的工作型態。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right? They even grow their plants.
dialogue.zh: 對吧？他們還自己種植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you feel reading it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hands went totally cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you cry a little maybe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two tears, do not tell Ben.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your brother is going to brag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will post it on his page.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl poʊst ɪt ɑn hɪz peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 他會發到他自己的頁面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a joke or a real plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə dʒoʊk ɔr ə ril plæn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He already texted the group chat.
dialogue.zh: 他已經傳到我們的群組了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole group knows then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty messages in ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘裡灌進二十則訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you answer every single one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sent one heart sticker.
dialogue.zh: 我只發了一個愛心貼圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very polite of you tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I would rather hear your voice.
dialogue.zh: 我還是比較想聽你的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should sleep a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep is not coming tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you eat dinner yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food? I forgot completely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go heat that soup up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right after this call.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not sign anything too fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits until Monday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Read every small line.
dialogue.zh: 聰明。每一行小字都要看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound like a lawyer now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send me the paper to read.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will find ten problems.
dialogue.zh: 你一定會挑出十個毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only five, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, but no red pen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you scared at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, mostly happy scared.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That kind is the best kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always say exactly that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Because it is true every time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, you win this round.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the exam in April?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Passed it, remember? Eighty-eight.
dialogue.zh: 通過了，記得嗎？八十八分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, that was your first win.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two wins in one good year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your mom will frame both.
dialogue.zh: 你媽會把兩張都裱起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She already framed my old diploma.
dialogue.zh: 我舊畢業證書早就裱好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what now for tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup, socks, and an early bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest now, phone face down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text you at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will bring the good cookies.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ones with salt on top?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I saved you two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You just became my favorite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, my head is getting big.
dialogue.zh: 別這樣，我會得意到不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours is already pretty big.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I am hanging up so slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, aɪ æm ˈhæŋɪŋ ʌp soʊ ˈsloʊli./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, stay, one more minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You still sound a bit crazy.
dialogue.zh: 你聽起來還是有點瘋狂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The happy kind, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get some sleep, future designer.
dialogue.zh: 睡一下吧，未來的設計師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, okay, good night then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, and proud of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best part today.
dialogue.zh: 那是今天最好的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, I want every detail.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring coffee and your ears.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There she is, our new hire!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shh, everyone is looking at me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come here, I need a real hug.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm hɪr, aɪ nid ə ril hʌɡ./
dialogue.zh: 過來，我要認真抱你一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, one very careful hug.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Congratulations, you earned all of it.
dialogue.zh: 恭喜你，這全是你自己賺來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for saying that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does it feel in daylight?
dialogue.zh: 白天再想這件事感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange, like a very good dream.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit, tell me from the start.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They called at ten sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not the email, an actual call?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the head of the studio.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What were your first words?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I said sorry three times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why sorry? Explain that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mouth was full of toast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that is very fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she laughed and asked my start date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi læft ænd æskt maɪ stɑrt deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 然後她笑著問我幾時上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you remember to answer her?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely. I said yes very loudly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee, two sugars, cookies too.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡，兩顆糖，餅乾也帶來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The salt ones, you remembered!
dialogue.zh: 撒鹽的那種，你居然還記得！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know your exact order.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is slightly scary, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any news about the pay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same as before, plus a bonus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bonus in the first year?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small, but still very exciting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And your old boss, does he know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jər oʊld bɔs, dʌz hi noʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, that is the hard talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, ðæt ɪz ðə hɑrd tɔk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want help with that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but thank you kindly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He will be glad for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some of him, maybe two parts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is in the contract, exactly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One year, then a review.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hours fixed, or flexible like now?
dialogue.zh: 工時固定，還是像現在這樣彈性？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine to five, with real breaks.
dialogue.zh: 九到五，還有真正的休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real breaks! That is huge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will finally bring a proper lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈfaɪnəli brɪŋ ə ˈprɑpər lʌntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我終於可以帶像樣的午餐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Vacation days in the deal?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen, and they count holidays too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Insurance, or is that extra?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Covered from the first week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like the people there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The team seemed really warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who walked you around the studio?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A girl named Rosa, so nice.
dialogue.zh: 一個叫 Rosa 的女生，超好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on your desk already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big window and one plant.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky you, my desk has none.
dialogue.zh: 真幸運，我桌上什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will get one for your desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡɛt wʌn fər jər dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 那我買一棵放到你桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First project, did they say?
dialogue.zh: 第一個專案，他們說了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A book cover with old photos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds just like your style.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have three ideas already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send one over tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will be my first viewer.
dialogue.zh: 你就變成我的第一位觀眾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any catch you worry about?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The training test in week two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another test? Really?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small one, I will be ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl wʌn, aɪ wɪl bi ˈrɛdi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You always are, that is the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔlˌweɪz ɑr, ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 你都準備好了，重點就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, my coffee is getting cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you tell your grandma face to face?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju tɛl jər ˈɡrændmɑ feɪs tə feɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She was crying right at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wəz ˈkraɪɪŋ raɪt æt ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, now I am too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at us, two grown children.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what did grandma say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She said I look like my mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd aɪ lʊk laɪk maɪ mɑm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else have you told?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben, Rosa, and my cousin Lin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only those few people?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I told no one at my old school.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ toʊld noʊ wʌn æt maɪ oʊld skul./
dialogue.zh: 我舊學校那邊一個都還沒說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your old teachers should hear it.
dialogue.zh: 你以前的老師會想聽到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One teacher there pushed me hardest.
dialogue.zh: 在那邊有位老師最挺我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then send her a card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What a lovely plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will keep it forever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write it by hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you still renting the same place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju stɪl ˈrɛntɪŋ ðə seɪm pleɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I can stay now.
dialogue.zh: 對，但我現在住得下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That word stay means a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means I can breathe, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any fear about Monday then?
dialogue.zh: 那到星期一還有什麼好怕的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only finding the right bus stop.
dialogue.zh: 只是怕找不到正確的車站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will ride with you once.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You hate the early bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For you, I will survive it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a real offer, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to celebrate this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I kind of hoped you would ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kaɪnd əv hoʊpt ju wʊd æsk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name a day, I am free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday? I feel calm by Friday.
dialogue.zh: 週五行嗎？到週五我就淡定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday, then. Book nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I need fancy clothes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear the green one you love.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with the wide sleeves?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the one, celebrate you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you pick the place.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pick it, you just smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I am a little worried.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worries, I know a quiet place.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz, aɪ noʊ ə ˈkwaɪət pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 放心，我知道一家安靜的店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one near the river?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has noodles and small plates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I do not want steak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, steak is too formal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And no loud music, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They play soft guitar, I checked.
dialogue.zh: 他們放輕柔的吉他，我查過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You planned this before today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Since last night, actually.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are too much sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit first, let me check tables.
dialogue.zh: 先坐，我查查還有沒有位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six people or just us two?
dialogue.zh: 六個人，還是只有我們兩個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought six, if you agree.
dialogue.zh: 我想約六個人，你同意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six feels like a real party.
dialogue.zh: 六個人就真的有派對感了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I make a playlist too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only songs we can talk over.
dialogue.zh: 只要是能邊聊邊聽的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, Rosa, Lin, and your brother.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My brother will bring dessert.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him for two desserts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He always buys the wrong cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, should I book right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Fridays fill up fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven o'clock, table for six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a high chair? Just kidding.
dialogue.zh: 要不要加張寶寶椅？開玩笑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, just six plates, no high chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, dʒʌst sɪks pleɪts, noʊ haɪ tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 哈，六個盤子就好，不用寶寶椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Book it under your name.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They asked what the occasion is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say a job well earned.
dialogue.zh: 就說是一份實至名歸的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I told them it is a party.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ toʊld ðɛm ɪt ɪz ə ˈpɑrti./
dialogue.zh: 我跟他們說是一場小聚會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which is true, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything you cannot eat now?
dialogue.zh: 有什麼是你現在不能吃的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No spicy on my plate, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, zero spicy for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And no cilantro for Ben.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He never says that to waiters.
dialogue.zh: 他從不跟服務員講這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I say it, I am the guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪ ɪt, aɪ æm ðə ɡɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guest who pays nothing, right?
dialogue.zh: 還是不用付錢的主角，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, I am bringing the flowers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, gifts. Should I bring one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not spend much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too late, I already looked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What number is too much for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈnʌmbər ɪz tu mʌtʃ fər ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing over thirty, still useful.
dialogue.zh: 不超過三十塊，實用的就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A nice pen for signing things.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you know about pens?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I mentioned it once, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mention everything twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how I remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, pen plus a good notebook.
dialogue.zh: 好，筆再加一本好筆記本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notebooks are my weak point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap enough, do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will still say you spent too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɪl seɪ ju spɛnt tu mʌtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about a card from all of us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ə kɑrd frʌm ɔl əv ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 那大家合寫一張卡片呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will cry at that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who signs it, me or Ben?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone, pass it around.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a small banner over there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No banner, please, I will hide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, no banner, just a toast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can handle a small toast.
dialogue.zh: 舉杯講兩句我還應付得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speech, two minutes, nothing more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You want me to speak?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only if you feel like it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will say three short lines.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I write it down first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do that, I will forget mine.
dialogue.zh: 寫吧，我那幾句一定會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we are both nervous.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should people arrive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say six thirty at the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we eat at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And no one arrives early, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben will arrive early anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him the door opens late.
dialogue.zh: 跟他說我們晚一點才開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take the metro there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, parking there is a war.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will buy everyone's tickets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are spending like a king.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only tonight, tomorrow I am poor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will lend you one coin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very kind, and very funny.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my whole gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, who is paying for dinner?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said it was your treat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I meant it, seriously.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I am buying the cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, chocolate or fruit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit, since it is warm outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Candles on it, of course?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No candles, I am not a kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkændəlz, aɪ æm nɑt ə kɪd./
dialogue.zh: 別插蠟燭，我又不是小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One candle, a very small flame.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but I blow it fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is carrying the cake here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben, he always brings big boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last thing, what should I wear?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not the loud shirt, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue shirt is loud?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is my lucky color, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Table six, look at this corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You got the best seats again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The best seats for the guest of honor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst sits fər ðə ɡɛst əv ˈɑnər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down before I cry here.
dialogue.zh: 快坐下，不然我要在這裡哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea, the way you like it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You remembered, no ice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember all your small rules.
dialogue.zh: 你那些小習慣我都記著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will make me blush now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Order whatever you want tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole menu, if I may.
dialogue.zh: 整份菜單，如果可以的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two noodles, one rice, some greens.
dialogue.zh: 兩份麵、一份飯、一點青菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the small dumplings, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, stop texting, look up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will post photos first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let him, it is good news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chat is full of congrats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Food is here, eat while hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This broth is unbelievable.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have the room a moment?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæv ðə rum ə ˈmoʊmənt?/
dialogue.zh: 借用大家一點時間好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, the toast begins.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Short, I promised two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You promised, so start talking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She worked through a hard year.
dialogue.zh: 她撐過了很艱難的一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, not the story yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one about the rainy bus?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that one stays hidden.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To new starts and brave plans.
dialogue.zh: 敬新的開始和勇敢的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To new starts, cheers, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your turn, three short lines.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote them on a napkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it slow, we are listening.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you all for being here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was only the first line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I forgot the rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say it to yourself: you did it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt tə jərˈsɛlf: ju dɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對著自己說一遍：你做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did it, my dear friend.
dialogue.zh: 你做到了，我親愛的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now everyone claps, on three.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that was nice, really.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pen, the book, plus this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɛn, ðə bʊk, plʌs ðɪs wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scarf? Is this for me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, your lucky blue. Put it on.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, jər ˈlʌki blu. pʊt ɪt ɑn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels so warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks perfect on you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always choose well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos, then, before the cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone must hold the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben can do it, he owes us one.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛn kæn du ɪt, hi oʊz ʌs wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 班可以幫忙拍，他還欠我們一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say ten photos, at least.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten is a lot for us two.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪz ə lɑt fər ʌs tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need one good photo, only one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid wʌn ɡʊd ˈfoʊtoʊ, ˈoʊnli wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我只要一張好的，就一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand by the window light.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is my hair a mess now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, do not touch it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready, tell him to count.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, three, got the shot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me, show me right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Group shot, everyone squeeze in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben, stop making that face.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one goes online tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write something kind about me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dessert time, lights low?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for the candle moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it comes, Ben carried it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says well done in white.
dialogue.zh: 上面用白色字寫著做得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make a wish, but quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wished it this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我今天早上就許過願了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then wish for the cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, pass me a plate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the fruit one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too sweet, exactly right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben took the biggest piece.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him, he saved us seats.
dialogue.zh: 讓他吧，他還幫我們搶位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee, or one last tea?
dialogue.zh: 要咖啡，還是最後一杯茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea, I am not done talking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bill came with no fight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tried to hide my wallet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is handled, do not move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I could have paid my share.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaving tips inside, come on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, let me thank the cook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, the air feels soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night air after a good dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your scarf is on backwards.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix it, I cannot reach.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me when you reach home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same rule, text me too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made it through a big week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ɪt θru ə bɪɡ wik./
dialogue.zh: 你把這一整週都撐過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means more than dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got home safe, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I kept the scarf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear it on your first day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you walk with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight sharp, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will be ten minutes late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday, we try your ideas.
dialogue.zh: 星期六我們試試你的想法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your pen, I will print.
dialogue.zh: 帶你的筆來，我負責列印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A short lake trip before Monday?
dialogue.zh: 週一前去湖邊小旅行好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you planned that already.
dialogue.zh: 好耶，你居然早就排好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, my clever friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, and thank you.
